items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Nobody but me and Elton Hill was there, and everyone in that band split, man.

ctx.x: And I never will forget those cats, man, when Gene got busted, man... Nobody but me and Elton Hill was there, and everyone in that band split, man. We (?) to help pack the stuff up, you know. Damn shame, man. I guess (?) the spirit. I come from a different time. When bands were together, they were together. If it's a crisis, everybody stuck in there, you know what I mean?
